skills.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to analyze a listed company (A-share, HK, or US) and produce a detailed deep-dive equity research report, e.g. 分析下XX公司, 做个XX的深度分析, 研究一下XX这家企业. It standardizes a 10-section framework (founding history, ownership evolution, main business, industry and competition, business model, moat, corporate culture, core financial analysis, shareholder returns, risks and one-line portrait), a parallel web-research method, and a polished single-file HTML report template with a cover, sticky nav, performance snapshot cards, and two-line financial tables. It also covers the financial-distortion discipline (归母 vs 扣非, FCF validation) and an optional HTML to PDF export.
